generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited. The registration of such tenderer shall also be cancelled.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned.
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (OLA)C, KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours.
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in.

PQR-1: Any organizations such as Academic/Research/Technical Institution, such as IITs, IISc, NITs or other reputed Government/Autonomous Engineering and Research Institutions having relevant expertise in geotechnical engineering, dam/embankment safety, ash pond stability or allied fields/ Engineering/Consultancy Organizations having NABL-accredited laboratory facilities, either in-house or through a valid tie-up/MoU with an NABL-accredited laboratory, for carrying out the required soil, ash, permeability, shear strength and other relevant geotechnical tests, are eligible for participation eligible to apply. As a proof, the intending bidder shall upload relevant documents.

PQR-2: Work Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one work of similar nature such as structural health assessment/stability analysis/integrity assessment of dam/embankment safety, ash pond stability/ earthen embankments/any civil structures of work value not less than Rs.12.60 Lakhs in the last Five completed financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of the same, the work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Competent Authority in case of State/Central Government/Government under taking/Public Sector Undertaking/any Private Industries/Organizations in India as the case may be uploaded (The value of the completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year (maximum of 50%) to bring them to the price level of the FY 2026-27).

PQR-3: Financial Turn over: The Intending bidder in PQR (1) should have achieved at least two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs.25.14 Lakhs during the last five completed financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of the same, intending eligible bidders as indicated in PQR (1) shall upload the certified copy of Turnover or Profit and Loss account certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY 2026-27).

itemList.description: Mobilization and demobilization charges for men and equipment to site and back.
Carrying out topographical survey of the embankment to establish the geometry of the bund at identified and critical locations Wherever feasible to take.

A) Drilling boreholes using Calyx drilling rig up to 10.0 m depth in soil or Drilling 7.0m in soil and 3.0 m in Soft Rock(N100), Drilling 8.5m in soil and 1.5m in rocky strata whichever is earlier. 
B) Laboratory test: Disturbed Samples/SPT Samples: Soil classification test like Sieve analysis, Liquid limit and Plastic limit samples and Undisturbed soil samples (UDS)-Triaxial/Direct/UCC shear test depending on the soil encountered at the site and classification tests at founding level
C) Analysis of test data, Furnishing report incorporating recommendations.

A) Drilling boreholes using Calyx drilling rig up to 20.0 m depth in soil or ii) Drilling 17.0m in soil and 3.0 m in Soft Rock(N100), Drilling 18.5m in soil and 1.5m in rocky strata whichever is earlier.
B)Laboratory Test: Disturbed Samples/SPT Samples: Soil classification test like Sieve analysis, Liquid limit and Plastic limit samples and Undisturbed soil samples (UDS)-Triaxial/Direct/UCC shear test depending on the soil encountered at the site and classification tests at founding level.
C)Analysis of test data, Furnishing report incorporating recommendations.

Collection of Soil Core sample at in situ condition below the existing formation level/Road Level, Conducting following index Properties test like Grain Size Analysis, Specific Gravity, Atterberg Limits, Collection of bulk disturbed sample and remoulding and carrying out Laboratory Soaked CBR and based on CBR Value arriving at Modulus of Subgrade Reaction (K-Value).

Examining the present existing sections of the bund at various chainages with reference to the available sections drawing. The bund stability will be checked considering the prevailing shear parameters using stability analysis software. Carrying out stability analysis of the embankment at identified critical sections and arriving at the condition of the bund in terms of stability & Furnishing report consisting of stability analysis results and recommendations for strengthening measures wherever required.

Hiring of 0.9cum capacity hydraulic excavator for trenching of Ash in Ash pond-1 & 2 whenever required  including transporation charges, charges of operating crew & all DPOL charges with all leads and lifts to the specified location as directed by the Engineer in charge at site etc., complete.

Hiring water Tanker (6 KL) for assisting drilling works of Ash in Ash pond-1 & 2 whenever required  including transporation charges, charges of operating crew & all DPOL charges with all leads and lifts to the specified location as directed by the Engineer in charge at site etc., complete.
